rows.meaning: able to speak a language well
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that someone speaks or uses a language fluently.

example.jyutping: ngo5 jing1 man4 gong2 dak1 hou2 lau4 lei6

rows.note: Use this for flowing, smooth handwriting or writing style rather than a person's language ability.

example.jyutping: keoi5 se2 ge3 man4 zoeng1 hou2 lau4 coeng3
